newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippines 1996 corn shortfall seen at 800,000 T.
newsitem.headline: Philippines 1996 corn shortfall seen at 800,000 T.

text.p: Philippine corn output is expected to reach 4.7 million tonnes this year against demand of 5.5 million, Agriculture undersecretary Domingo Panganiban said on Friday.
Last week, Philippine hog raisers and feed millers said they plan to import up to 300,000 tonnes of corn in the fourth quarter this year.
The Philippines has so far imported 250,000 tonnes of corn from the United States and Argentina since the start of the year for animal feed.
"The Department of Agriculture is looking into improving local corn production to address the shortfall," Panganiban told reporters.
Panganiban said the Philippine corn shortfall in 1995 reached 700,000, with local output reaching 4.7 million tonnes.
